date_selection: Chronologically first 14 service dates with verified unused real outcomes and joint availability of a valid static feed, actual endpoint archive and capture-timestamped predecision GTFS-RT. Check source metadata before opening values. Synthetic pseudo-date experiments alone do not imply real-target exposure. No used date substitutes for a missing new date.

fixed.physical_and_working_model: V41, using existing reconstruction_v34/model_fit.json and reconstruction_v35/fitted_emission.json; no refit or new cancellation/forecast law
fixed.menu: decision_gap_v1 uniform upstream-prefix closure on the existing V50 menu recipe, preserving original transfer depth; no label-driven candidate or root selection
fixed.information: Original public message receipt clock, own/local observations, entry versus ready, MCT and horizon; no actual future in P0 predictions
fixed.root_selection: Use original V34 public structural catalogue and fixed round-robin direct/shared/two-transfer order, one incoming vehicle and route/OD, at most12 per date, before endpoint completeness or forecast values. Retain missing initial histories as unresolved; missing forecasts remain the no-numeric-forecast group.
fixed.events: Every chosen root's first public legal onboard state; register all candidate/later-exit pairs before labels; absent through departures, canceled, missing and ambiguous endpoints remain in the ledger

primary.target: Four joint catch partitions 00,01,10,11 under the fixed operational clock and MCT
primary.bias: Observed indicator minus root-P0 probability; unknown indicators use possible-partition bounds and unknown model probabilities use [0,1]
primary.weighting: Within each date, group events sharing either incoming or outgoing physical trip into connected operational incidents; average event residuals within incidents, then equally over incidents and dates. Also report the full opportunity-weighted denominator.
primary.margin_rationale: Predeclared screening tolerance of one excess or missing event per50 comparable opportunities. This is a research design choice, not a published universal standard or a travel-regret certificate.
primary.interval: 20000 fixed-seed bootstrap replicates resampling whole dates with all incident/event rows intact. For each partition use percentiles0.00625 and0.99375 (Bonferroni allocation across four two-sided intervals, nominal family95%). Apply lower-tail calculation to missingness lower bounds and upper-tail calculation to upper bounds. Seed20261115; no additional looks or budget extension.
primary.pass: All14 predeclared dates represented, each with at least one structural opportunity, and all four entire intervals lie inside [-0.02,0.02]. This is a day-cluster screening conclusion for the declared population.
primary.fail: At least one partition interval lies wholly above0.02 or wholly below-0.02; retain the direction and all other partitions.
primary.unresolved: Fewer than14 eligible dates, a missing whole date or unknown opportunity denominator, or intervals that neither establish equivalence nor establish an excess. A nonsignificant difference is not a pass.
primary.assumptions: Date-level resampling is approximate and assumes the selected date clusters are reasonably representative;14 dates do not establish arbitrary conditional calibration or finite-sample coverage under unrestricted temporal dependence. Report every day and weekday, including missing days.

secondary.groups: Frozen forecast-age, MCT-difference and downstream-option-count groups from decision_gap_v1; report all groups and date coverage without selecting winners
secondary.scores: Four-class Brier score bounds over feasible label partitions; cancellations, forecast residuals and source-reach failure causes separately
secondary.claims: Sparse or missing groups remain unresolved. Aggregate equivalence does not establish equivalence in every subgroup.

platform_verification.planned_pair: Recover full stop_id by same-version static trip_id and stop_sequence; verify station and scheduled time; use explicit directed platform rule or an applicable true location_type=1 ancestor rule. A bare BPUIC with location_type empty/0 is not a parent-station wildcard.
platform_verification.actual_pair: Require dated operational platform identity for both arrivals and departures. Planned stops and predecision assignments alone are not verified actual platforms.
platform_verification.pass: All registered relevant transfer pairs have identified actual endpoints and an applicable published transfer rule consistent with the frozen MCT; report the exact scope.
platform_verification.fail: A verified applicable rule contradicts the fixed MCT or prohibits a declared transfer; retain and report it without changing buffers in this experiment.
platform_verification.unresolved: Missing platform identity or no unambiguous applicable rule. Absence of a self-transfer row does not imply zero transfer time.

decision: A failed or unresolved probability/operating-contract check does not admit deep solver reconstruction. Passing both only permits a separately frozen feasible-policy-gap test against the strengthened cheap controls; it does not pass G2 or establish a novel algorithm.
